name: Liability-threshold variance-explained prediction framework
model_likelihood: Binary disease is threshold exceedance of normal latent liability; normally distributed measurable liability is the known-risk component.
inference_algorithm: Evaluate model-implied classification probabilities over percentile cut-offs and integrate ROC; optional binormal approximation using Pearson-Aitken conditional moments.
estimand: Risk distribution; AUC; discrimination slope; reclassification improvement; proportion of cases in high-risk population percentiles.
data_input: Population disease probability K and total liability variance explained Vm; no individual-level fitting algorithm specified here.
tunable_settings: Classification percentile or absolute-risk thresholds; risk-percentile range of interest.
